priorities.work: Primitive boxing, primitive prototype objects, and complete builtin function metadata/descriptors
priorities.evidence: Runtime unsupported diagnostics dominate conversions and arrays. Source signals show new String/Number/Boolean, String.prototype access and builtin metadata reads. Diagnostics alone do not determine which branch failed.
priorities.validation: Add focused GPU cases; rerun selected conversion/array subsets against pinned source.

priorities.work: Object.create second properties argument via existing descriptor conversion pipeline
priorities.evidence: Object/create accounts for 524 conversion unsupported variants across all causes. Direct source inspection of 15.2.3.5-4-1.js exercises the currently rejected properties argument; metadata-only 15.2.3.5-0-2.js is another separate blocker. Do not interpret 524 as all fixable by this one change.
priorities.validation: Descriptor getter ordering, abrupt completion and no partial definition during descriptor collection.

priorities.work: for-in enumeration and missing compile-time operations
priorities.evidence: for_in_start blocks 100 conversion and 214 descriptor variants. Array pow/regexp and conversion to_object/push_bigint_i32 have distinct missing semantics.
priorities.validation: Own/inherited enumeration, mutation and dispatch resumption; language-specific conformance batches.

priorities.work: Symbols and conversion hooks, then remaining standard globals
priorities.evidence: Exact compile diagnostics identify Symbol, Date, RegExp, Math, JSON, Proxy, eval and other globals. These are dependency blockers, not proof each test would pass once the global name exists.
priorities.validation: Implement observable semantics and descriptors, never placeholder success or CPU replay.

priorities.work: Resolve resource limits separately from missing semantics
priorities.evidence: Array classified report has 18 resource-limited variants: preserve original outcomes; no rerun occurred in classification.
priorities.validation: Replay targeted resource cases with measured heap/string/dispatch requirements; retain unresolved outcomes until GPU evidence exists.
